players.product: Data-center liquid-cooling systems on the facility side (cold-plate and immersion: CDUs, secondary-side piping and manifolds, server cold plates, fluid connectors, immersion tanks; pump-driven two-phase cold-plate system in development) for leading internet companies and IDC operators, alongside HVDC converter-valve and energy-storage liquid cooling

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 results (quarterly report): Q3 revenue RMB 273,370,966.99, up 60.78% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 34,802,095.52, up 207.89%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 34,479,700.80, up 293.72%. First nine months: revenue RMB 766,977,750.95, up 30.49%; net profit attributable RMB 60,534,745.32, up 76.82%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 59,070,661.99, up 122.11%; operating cash flow RMB -98,271,082.29, down 186.45%. The company attributes the revenue growth mainly to higher revenue from thermal management products for high-power-density equipment.

Orders and inventory (quarterly report): prepayments rose 57.27% to RMB 58,439,989.43 at September 30, 2026 because orders on hand increased and the company paid larger contractual prepayments to its main suppliers; inventory rose 48.40% to RMB 810,305,423.35, mainly more goods shipped but not yet recognised; cash paid for goods and services rose 66.13% to RMB 534,356,920.93 as procurement reserves grew; construction in progress rose to RMB 5,594,604.01 as a subsidiary bought production lines and equipment not yet in use.
